description: Mapped in OpenStreetMap as historic=memorial with memorial=aircraft and the Korean name 해상초계기 meaning maritime patrol aircraft; namu.wiki confirms retired military equipment including aircraft in the outdoor plaza beside the preserved LST 운봉함; the type is NOT named by either source. A Grumman S-2 Tracker is the obvious candidate for a Korean maritime patrol monument but nothing supports that and it is not asserted
